class_doc: Covers the non-signed-in "find medicines" flow for the BCBS Alabama plan: choose plan -> search a drug -> verify dosage/quantity and drug-list (formulary) status against data captured directly from myprime.com. Expected values live in src/test/resources/testdata/expected-drugs.json so the oracle data is separated from the test logic.

tests.name: genericDrug_isOnDrugList_withCorrectTierAndDosage
tests.test_description: Generic drug (atorvastatin calcium) should be on the plan's drug list with the correct dosage and Tier 1/Preferred Generic status

assertions.message: Dose info on the result card did not match expected dosage/quantity
Formulary status on the result card did not match expected value
Expected this generic to be marked \"On drug list\" on the details page
Test data sanity check: this drug should be flagged onDrugList=true
